stableFactsAndClaims: The narrator borrowed an arts-cupboard recorder and read instructions the night before, expecting early rising to be the main challenge.
At 5:20 Sunday, an obsolete spare key failed after a lock replacement; waiting for Farah caused missed initial birdsong.
Farah came to water beans, admitted the narrator, and showed a dry equipment location.
A van, dragged bin, and jacket added sounds; headphones revealed jacket noise and a wooden crate helped only that problem.
Three clips of about four minutes were recorded; the middle includes a visually recognized blackbird, while other birds remain unidentified.
Traffic is part of the morning's sound; the result was a small record of the place waking, not pure birdsong.
Next weekend the narrator wants to check the key and use a tripod; an earlier start remains undecided because delivery schedules are unknown.
